summary: Afya Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting held on June 22, 2026, where shareholders approved and ratified the company's financial statements for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign is disclosed; the filing is a routine foreign private issuer report of meeting outcomes. No deal terms are present, and no management change or strategic review is announced. This is a regulatory update with no actionable special-situation angle.
